candidates.snippet: @alarm_phone 102 people alive today because NGOs did what EU states are legally bound to do and refuse to. We don't know the fate of everyone else we spotted. Civil society is filling a gap states created and abandon daily. Survivors deserve a future, not indifference.

@alarm_phone 21 Sept: another Mayday Relay from an unknown station. We flew out and found 24 people fighting for their lives at sea. Sea-Eye 5 answered the call EU authorities didn't, and rescued everyone on board.

@alarm_phone A Libyan militia boat closed in -  these 31 people could have been dragged back to Libya. MSF's Oyvon reached them in time. That same day we spotted a black rubber boat, 47 people aboard: NGO ship Solidaire rescued them all, just in time.
